**Findings**

- Medium: [`worktreeParentCandidate`](file:///Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_experiments/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/lifecycle.go) at [lifecycle.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_experiments/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/lifecycle.go:264) uses `strings.Index(projectSeg, claudeWorktreeMarker)`, which cuts at the first `--claude-worktrees-` occurrence. That breaks valid repos whose sanitized root already contains that token. Example: a repo rooted at `/Users/me/acme--claude-worktrees-tools/repo` and run from Claude’s worktree feature would produce a project segment like `-Users-me-acme--claude-worktrees-tools-repo--claude-worktrees-feature`; the current code truncates it to `-Users-me-acme`, so the fallback points at the wrong project dir and the dropped-checkpoint bug still reproduces for that class of repos. The added tests only cover the simple “marker appears once as the synthetic suffix” case in [lifecycle_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_experiments/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/lifecycle_test.go:548) and [claude_worktree_path_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_experiments/cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/claude_worktree_path_test.go:34), so this regression would not be caught.
